name: Thai chicken cakes with sweet chilli sauce
assumptions: Yield of 6 cakes from explicit instruction to shape six small cakes; each cake is one serving
Total time estimated from instructions: ~5 min prep (blitzing + shaping) + 6-8 min frying = ~15 min; rounded up to 20 min to include seasoning, heating oil, and serving prep
Sweet chilli sauce treated as potential source of wheat/soy/sesame (common in commercial versions) hence null
Lime, spring onions, and red chilli are garnishes served with the cakes
No explicit gluten-containing ingredients; gluten-free marked null due to unspecified sweet chilli sauce
No tree nuts or peanuts listed; marked false as confidently absent
No fish or shellfish listed; marked null due to potential in some sweet chilli sauces
instructions:
step 1
Toss the chicken, garlic, ginger, onion, coriander and chilli into a food processor and season well. Blitz until the chicken is finely ground and everything is well mixed. Use your hands to shape six small cakes.

step 2
Heat the oil in a frying pan, then fry the cakes over a medium heat for about 6-8 mins, turning once. Serve hot, with sweet chilli sauce, lime wedges, coriander, shredded spring onion and red chilli.

ingredients.name: Chicken Breast
ingredients.assumptions: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts ≈400g total; raw weight used as ground in processor before frying

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.assumptions: 1 small knob of fresh ginger, peeled

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons olive oil for frying (≈14g per tbsp)

ingredients.name: sweet chilli sauce
ingredients.assumptions: Sweet chilli sauce to serve; assumed 2 tbsp (30ml) per cake for 6 cakes, total 60g as typical serving amount for the dish

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: Lime to serve; assumed 1 whole lime cut into wedges (≈100g with peel, edible portion considered)

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: Chopped spring onions to serve; assumed 3-4 stalks, ≈30g total garnish amount

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: Chopped red chilli to serve; assumed 1 small red chilli, ≈15g total garnish amount
